trigger: Before starting a software project task that changes workflow assets
When planning, reviewing, or validating project-governance work

ask_user_question.evidence: Claude adapter can route user interaction through the host conversation, but this repository cannot prove a portable native AskUserQuestion tool across all Claude-compatible runtimes.
ask_user_question.degraded_mode: Use the host interaction channel and record degraded evidence when a native AskUserQuestion tool is unavailable.

sub_agent.evidence: Claude Code supports Agent-style delegation used by the workflow's Agent Team routing.

tool_calling.evidence: Claude Code runtime E2E uses filesystem/read tools and local validation commands.

browser.evidence: Browser automation depends on installed host/browser tooling, not the adapter entry itself.
browser.degraded_mode: Mark browser validation blocked or use an available browser plugin when the host exposes one.

mcp.evidence: MCP availability depends on user host configuration.
mcp.degraded_mode: Use local scripts and record MCP unavailable when no MCP server is configured.

git_hooks.evidence: Workflow installs and validates pre-commit, commit-msg, and post-commit hooks.

workflow_closure.evidence: Entry and Agent Team routing are strong, but AskUserQuestion, browser, and MCP remain host-dependent.

exploration_channels.note: M10.3 four behavior-semantic channels materialized for this platform. consult never maps draw: generation is not consultation (生成≠咨询 — canonical rule marker synced from behavior-protocol.md M10.3, drift-guarded by check-cross-references; origin review-FEAT-085-DESIGN-R0 F-3). Honest degradation is legal; capability masquerade is an EXP-03 violation.

discover.mapping: host web search tooling (e.g. WebSearch), when the host plan exposes it
discover.evidence: This repo's Claude runtime E2E verified filesystem/read tools and local validation commands only; web discovery remains host/plan dependent and is not proven by this adapter's evidence.
discover.degraded_mode: Record 判定=受限 per EXP-03 when web tooling is unavailable; never mark offline knowledge as search results.

inspect.evidence: Claude Code runtime E2E uses filesystem/read tools (runtime_capabilities.tool_calling native).

consult.mapping: Agent-style delegation for structured second opinions; host web search when available
consult.evidence: Agent-style delegation is native (runtime_capabilities.sub_agent), but no web-backed professional-agent consult channel is verified in this adapter; draw-style generation is not consultation (R0 F-3).
consult.degraded_mode: Degrade to host-conversation consultation and record the channel limit per EXP-03; do not claim external professional judgment that was not obtained.

validate.mapping: verify_workflow.py / test execution via local validation commands
validate.evidence: Local validation commands are part of this adapter's verified tool calling, and validation.command + git hooks are required (runtime_capabilities.tool_calling/git_hooks native).

exploration_channels.degraded_mode: When a channel is unavailable, record 判定=受限 in the exploration block (M10.2) per EXP-03; never mark offline knowledge as channel results.
